name: Canonical Port Fixed Trade Modes
description: Class 1 SBB ORE mode remains fixed as stock changes and trade attempts run

tests.name: Setup: Port mode player
Rig: Put class 1 port and player in sector two

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET type = 1, sector_id = 2 WHERE port_id = 2

tests.name: Rig: Configure SBB to sell ORE and stock it at zero

data.sql: DELETE FROM port_trade WHERE port_id = 2 AND commodity = 'ORE'

tests.name: Rig: Seed fixed SBB ORE sell mode

data.sql: INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, commodity, mode, maxproduct) VALUES (2, 'ORE', 'sell', 5000)

tests.name: Rig: Set SBB ORE inventory to zero

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity, price, last_updated_ts) VALUES ('port', 2, 'ORE', 0, 100, 0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 0

tests.name: Rig: Move player and ship into SBB sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 2 WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id}

tests.name: Rig: Move player ship into SBB sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 2 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id})

tests.name: Rig: Give player ORE so an incorrectly enabled sell would execute

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'ORE', 1 FROM players WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id} ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 1

tests.name: Rig: Cloak ship and clear port knowledge for rejection checks

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET cloaked = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id}); DELETE FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id} AND port_id = 2

tests.name: Refresh port mode player's sector
Capture state before zero-stock rejected sell

data.sql: SELECT p.credits, t.turns_remaining, COALESCE((SELECT c.quantity FROM ship_cargo c WHERE c.ship_id = p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code = 'ORE'), 0), COALESCE((SELECT s.quantity FROM entity_stock s WHERE s.entity_type = 'port' AND s.entity_id = 2 AND s.commodity_code = 'ORE'), 0), (SELECT count(*) FROM trade_log l WHERE l.player_id = p.player_id AND l.port_id = 2 AND l.commodity = 'ORE' AND l.action = 'sell'), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ships sh WHERE sh.ship_id = p.ship_id AND sh.cloaked IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, (SELECT count(*) FROM player_known_ports k WHERE k.player_id = p.player_id AND k.port_id = 2) FROM players p JOIN turns t USING (player_id) WHERE p.player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id}

tests.name: SBB does not buy ORE from player when stock is zero
Rejected zero-stock sell leaves all player and port state unchanged

data.sql: SELECT p.credits, t.turns_remaining, COALESCE((SELECT c.quantity FROM ship_cargo c WHERE c.ship_id = p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code = 'ORE'), 0), COALESCE((SELECT s.quantity FROM entity_stock s WHERE s.entity_type = 'port' AND s.entity_id = 2 AND s.commodity_code = 'ORE'), 0), (SELECT count(*) FROM trade_log l WHERE l.player_id = p.player_id AND l.port_id = 2 AND l.commodity = 'ORE' AND l.action = 'sell'), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ships sh WHERE sh.ship_id = p.ship_id AND sh.cloaked IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, (SELECT count(*) FROM player_known_ports k WHERE k.player_id = p.player_id AND k.port_id = 2) FROM players p JOIN turns t USING (player_id) WHERE p.player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id}

tests.name: Rig: Add ORE stock without changing SBB mode

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity, price, last_updated_ts) VALUES ('port', 2, 'ORE', 100, 100, 0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 100

tests.name: Rig: Preserve cloak and clear knowledge before positive-stock rejection

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET cloaked = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id}); DELETE FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id} AND port_id = 2

data.sql: SELECT p.credits, t.turns_remaining, COALESCE((SELECT c.quantity FROM ship_cargo c WHERE c.ship_id = p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code = 'ORE'), 0), COALESCE((SELECT s.quantity FROM entity_stock s WHERE s.entity_type = 'port' AND s.entity_id = 2 AND s.commodity_code = 'ORE'), 0), (SELECT count(*) FROM trade_log l WHERE l.player_id = p.player_id AND l.port_id = 2 AND l.commodity = 'ORE' AND l.action = 'sell'), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ships sh WHERE sh.ship_id = p.ship_id AND sh.cloaked IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, (SELECT count(*) FROM player_known_ports k WHERE k.player_id = p.player_id AND k.port_id = 2) FROM players p JOIN turns t USING (player_id) WHERE p.player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id}
